flaps._comment: A330-900neo flap lever positions 0-4. Config 1 is transitional; lever position 1 selects Config 1+F. Aircraft-specific speed limits remain provisional until supported by vendor documentation.

grades._comment: Provisional wide-body landing-rate bands pending aircraft-specific source verification.

telemetry._comment: Headwind does not publish a compatibility contract for the complete FlyByWire interface, so standard SimConnect is the only active telemetry path pending A339X-specific verification.

controls._comment: The exact Headwind adapter exposes only bounded cockpit and flight-display lighting presets, checked against the installed A330_NEO_INTERIOR.xml. Other custom cockpit writes remain unmapped.

meta.notes: Headwind A330-900neo (A330-941, Trent 7000) identity profile. Headwind documents its FBW A32NX heritage but does not publish a complete external-interface compatibility contract. Custom readbacks and writes remain unmapped; standard SimConnect is the live path pending A339X-specific verification.

sources.name: Headwind A339X source repository
sources.notes: Official Headwind project repository. Documents that the A339X is based on the FlyByWire System A32NX and identifies the A330-941 / Trent 7000 target aircraft. No inherited aircraft-specific variables are activated without a documented compatibility contract and in-sim verification.

sources.name: Headwind A339X product page
sources.notes: Official Headwind A339X product page confirming the aircraft is based on FlyByWire A32NX, includes SimBridge resources, and targets the Airbus A330-900neo.

sources.name: FlyByWire A32NX Flight Deck API
sources.notes: Documents the FlyByWire A32NX flight-deck interface. This profile does not assume those aircraft-specific routes are compatible with the Headwind A339X.

sources.name: FlyByWire A32NX Developer API
sources.notes: Documents the FlyByWire A32NX systems interface. This profile does not activate inherited A32NX routes without a Headwind compatibility contract.

sources.name: Headwind aircraft releases
sources.notes: Release history records FBW Core Module updates, demonstrating why inherited A32NX interfaces must be revalidated per Headwind release rather than assumed compatible.

sources.name: Installed Headwind A339X cockpit lighting behavior
sources.notes: The installed headwindsim-aircraft-a330-900 SimObjects/Airplanes/Headwind_A330neo/model/A330_NEO_INTERIOR.xml explicitly assigns cockpit panel potentiometers 84,87,85,86; flood 83,76; PFD/ND/weather/ECAM displays 88,89,94,90,91,95,92,93. Uses the standard LIGHT_POTENTIOMETER_SET index then percentage contract, with independent knob readback. Discrete ceiling/map and dome controls are excluded. No general A32NX compatibility is inferred.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator SDK - indexed cockpit light potentiometers
sources.notes: LIGHT_POTENTIOMETER_SET takes potentiometer index in parameter 0, brightness percentage in parameter 1. Aircraft-specific indices are grounded separately in vendor evidence. The caller supplies only a bounded whole percentage.

sources.name: Installed aircraft exterior lighting selectors and light indices
sources.notes: A330_NEO_INTERIOR.xml: paired landing lamps LIGHT LANDING:2 and LIGHT LANDING:3. Both aircraft use LIGHT TAXI:1 for nose taxi lighting, LIGHT TAXI:2 and LIGHT TAXI:3 for runway turnoff lamps. Bounded LANDING_LIGHTS_SET and TAXI_LIGHTS_SET events use state first, fixed light index second, matching the shipped switch templates. All changed indexed outputs require independent newer readback. Existing takeoff preset actions are retained. See docs/EXTERIOR-LIGHTS-VALIDATION.md.

knownIssues: No inherited A32NX_* telemetry is active because the cited Headwind sources do not define compatibility for those exact interfaces.
Custom FCU writes remain inactive because the cited Headwind sources do not define them and the current MSFS provider has no applicable custom-event route.
Flap lever value mapping (0-4 indices) not confirmed in MSFS
A330 Config 1 (slats only, 240 kt) is not a dedicated lever position in MSFS implementation — lever 1 = Config 1+F
